# Soap Bubble Control Center

A glass-style Android Control Center demo.

## Features

- Liquid glass inspired interface
- Soap bubble visual design
- Wi-Fi and Bluetooth demo tiles
- Brightness and volume sliders
- Dark glass background

## Build

The project uses GitHub Actions to build a debug APK.

Open the Actions tab to check the build status.

## Note

This is a visual demo. Controls do not change actual Android system settings.
